method: Read-only runtime property extraction compared to original repository RBXM assets through pinned Lune. Separate read-only reconstruction of all source fingerprint rows replaced only standalone negative-zero CFrame tokens in MountTemplates; no Instance properties, source assets, tests, or fingerprint module changed.
resolution: Canonicalize only complete comma-delimited CFrame text tokens equal to -0 into 0. Preserve every bank, descendant, class, Size, Model scale, and all nonzero numeric text. No source Instance or asset mutation.
regression: .lune/template-fingerprint.luau executes the actual module with isolated source-bank doubles; scripts/tests/template-fingerprint.test.mjs includes it in Node tests. Signed-zero equivalence passes; nonzero and tiny negative coordinates, size, scale, other-bank changes remain detectable.
